type.quote: The authority of the board is expanded to allow the board to examine, certify, and regulate heating, air conditioning, and refrigeration on a statewide basis.

exams.name: Written examination for certified contractor
exams.notes: Applicant failing the first examination may take a subsequent written or practical examination within six months. Applicants must stand for the examination within one year from the date the board receives the examination application.
exams.quote: All prospective certified contractors in this state seeking to qualify in accordance with this chapter shall be required to stand for a written examination before the board.

available.quote: The board may enter into reciprocity agreements with other states to permit Alabama certified contractors to engage in work in other states in exchange for that state's contractors being permitted to perform work in Alabama.

requirements.value: Reciprocity agreements may be entered with other states; the certified contractor must have passed the examination, and all certification fees are required to be paid.
requirements.quote: This provision recognizes the status of the certified contractor as having passed the examination; however, all certification fees are required to be paid.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may reprimand a contractor who provides substandard or dangerous service, repair, or installation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may reprimand, in writing, any certified contractor who provides substandard or dangerous service, repair, or installation, or who otherwise violates this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may remove, revoke, or suspend certification for violating the chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may remove, revoke, or suspend the certification of any certified contractor who provides substandard or dangerous service, repair, or installation, or who otherwise violates this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may remove the certification of a contractor who fails to renew by March 1.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may also remove the certification from any certified individual who fails to renew his or her certificate by the first day of March and require the individual to apply for a new certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certified contractors who fail to comply with minimum repair and service standards shall be punished.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Certified contractors who fail to comply with such minimum standards and criteria shall be punished as prescribed in Section 34-31-32(a).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cease work after board notification renders an individual ineligible for certification for up to one year.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any failure to cease work, after a hearing and notification from the board, shall render an individual ineligible to apply for a certified contractor's license for a period not to exceed one year from the date of official notification to cease work.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to complete minimum continuing education requirements prevents renewal of the certified contractor's license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to complete the minimum continuing education requirements shall prevent the renewal of the certified contractor's license until proof of compliance with the continuing education requirement is submitted to the board.

bonding_required.quote: The board may require a performance bond not to exceed twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) per year for all active certified contractors.
